name: com.thesolobillion/the-solo-billion
title: The Solo Billion
description: Sourced revenue data on solo founders racing to the first one-person $1B company. Read-only.

tools.name: search_founders
tools.description: Search solo founders (one founder, team of five or fewer) with sourced revenue. Filter by text, category, solo status and yearly revenue pace. Returns ranked founders with pace, distance to $1B a year and a link to their sourced profile.

query.description: Free text: founder, company, niche (e.g. 'mobile app', 'SEO', 'Postiz')

category.description: Category name or slug; see list_categories

min_pace_usd.description: Minimum yearly revenue pace in USD

tools.name: get_founder
tools.description: Full sourced profile of one founder: every revenue figure with date, source link and verbatim quote, revenue history, solo status, caveats and (when available) a blueprint for starting a similar business.

tools.name: get_blueprint
tools.description: How to start a business like this founder's: product, customer, pricing, acquisition channels, stack and timeline (each with a source), plus labelled analysis: first steps, adjacent ideas, difficulty, capital and risks.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Categories on the board with founder counts and the top yearly pace in each.

tools.name: race_summary
tools.description: The state of the race to the first one-person $1B company: leader, distance to $1B, counts in the $1M/$10M/$100M clubs, median distance.

tools.name: search_ai_businesses
tools.description: Search plug-and-play business models where AI agents can do most of the work (late 2026): who pays, AI-run share, startup cost, time to first dollar, skill level and an honest monthly revenue estimate, with founders on the board who run one. Filters are optional.

category.description: Category name or slug, e.g. 'Local business services', 'software-and-apps'

ai_share.description: high = AI does 65%+, mid = 55-64%, low = 54% or less

startup_cost.description: Upper end of first-month cash in USD

first_dollar.description: Slow end of the estimate: fast = by week 6, medium = by month 3, slow = longer

tools.name: get_ai_business
tools.description: Full playbook for one AI-run business model: how AI runs each job (customers, product, delivery, support, billing) with named tools, their prices and price sources, steps that still need a person, sourced examples with verbatim quotes, risks, a day 1 to day 30 launch checklist, copy-paste prompts and who should not do it.
